    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AIPlayer
    AI player that makes decisions with realistic timing delays.
    Card
    Represents a playing card with a rank and suit.
    Deck
    Deck of standard 52 playing cards.
    EmptyDeckException
    Thrown when attempting to draw from an empty deck.
    GameEngine
    Core game engine implementing the rules of "Cincuentazo" (50-taZo).
    GameLoopManager
    Manages the game loop and turn execution for both human and AI players.
    GameUnoController
    Controller for the main game view.
    GameUnoView
    Manages loading and display of the game UI.
    Main
    Main entry point for the Cincuentazo game application.
    NoPlayableCardException
    Thrown when a player has no playable card given the current table sum.
    Player
    Represents a player (human or machine) and manages the player's hand.
    Rank
    Card ranks used in the game.
    Suit
    Card suits.
    WelcomeStageController
    Controller for the welcome/main menu stage.
